name: À la table Furniture
old_description: At A LA TABLE we believe unique spaces deserve unique furniture.
about:
À la table Furniture operates from Spring, Texas, under the name C. Schmidt & Sons. The founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, though the Schmidt family name suggests a family-led operation. The company began with a focus on crafting custom furniture for unique spaces.

The workshop produces a range of hand-made and hand-finished pieces, including trestle tables, farm tables, coffee tables, buffets, hutches, custom media cabinets, office desks, bookcases, kitchen islands, fireplace mantels, benches, and dining chairs. Each item is built to order, with no mention of standardized production runs, facility size, or employee headcount.

The company serves individual clients seeking one-of-a-kind furnishings for residential settings. No specific industries, commercial sectors, or named customers are referenced in available materials.

The founder’s stated vision is that unique spaces deserve unique furniture, a philosophy realized through bespoke design and hand-finishing rather than mass production. This approach is presented as the core differentiator, though no measurable performance metrics or guarantees are provided.
